body: Philippine Airlines (PAL) has begun operating its flagship Airbus A350-1000 daily between Manila's Ninoy Aquino International Airport and San Francisco International Airport ahead of the year-end peak travel season. The daily service gives West Coast travelers access to the carrier's newest long-haul product every day of the week and adds premium seats in a season when many Filipino Americans travel home for the holidays.

San Francisco is one of PAL's most important North American gateways and a key link to the large Filipino American community on the West Coast, with onward connections via Manila to destinations across the Philippines and the wider Asia-Pacific region. The A350-1000 is PAL's newest and largest aircraft type, seating 382 passengers: 42 business-class suites in a 1-2-1 layout, 24 premium economy seats and 316 economy seats, each cabin fitted with 4K in-flight entertainment screens, in-flight Wi-Fi, seat power and USB-A and USB-C charging ports. PAL says the type also offers better fuel efficiency, greater operational flexibility and larger cargo capacity to support long-haul network growth. Flight PR104 departs Manila at 23:15 local time and arrives in San Francisco at 20:45 through October 31, while return flight PR105 departs San Francisco at 23:40 and arrives in Manila at 05:35. From November 1, PR104 arrives at 19:45 and PR105 departs at 22:40, with the Manila arrival unchanged at 05:35, a shift the article links to the end of daylight saving time in the United States on November 1.
en.summary: Philippine Airlines has begun operating its flagship Airbus A350-1000 daily between Manila and San Francisco ahead of the year-end peak, offering 382 seats including 42 business-class suites, with schedule adjustments from November 1.
en.title: PAL deploys A350-1000 daily on Manila-San Francisco route ahead of year-end peak

body: 菲律賓航空已在年底旅遊高峰來臨前，開始以旗艦機型空中巴士A350-1000每天往返馬尼拉尼諾伊·阿基諾國際機場與舊金山國際機場。每天一班的服務讓美國西岸旅客在一週中的每一天都能搭乘該公司最新的長程產品，並在許多菲律賓裔美國人返鄉過節的繁忙季節來臨前增加高階座位。

舊金山是菲律賓航空最重要的北美門戶之一，也是連結美國西岸龐大菲律賓裔美國人社群的關鍵航點，旅客可經由馬尼拉轉往菲律賓各地及更廣泛的亞太地區目的地。A350-1000是菲律賓航空機隊最新且最大的機型，共設382個座位，包括42個採1-2-1配置的商務艙套房、24個豪華經濟艙座位與316個經濟艙座位，各艙等均配備4K機上娛樂螢幕、機上Wi-Fi、座位電源以及USB-A與USB-C充電埠。菲律賓航空表示，該機型還具備更佳燃油效率、更高的營運彈性與更大的貨運容量，有助於長程航網成長。航班時刻方面，截至10月31日，PR104於當地時間23:15自馬尼拉出發、20:45抵達舊金山；回程PR105於當地時間23:40自舊金山出發、05:35抵達馬尼拉。自11月1日起，PR104仍於當地時間23:15自馬尼拉出發、改為19:45抵達舊金山，PR105改為當地時間22:40自舊金山出發、仍於05:35抵達馬尼拉，時刻調整與美國於11月1日結束日光節約時間有關。

zh.title: 菲律賓航空以A350-1000每天往返馬尼拉與舊金山，迎接年底旅遊高峰
